fixed_selection: Only interior jar visits where immediately previous and next Euplotes counts >0 and all three sample volumes positive; central count may be zero or positive. No cherry-picked treatment or zero run length.
observation_likelihood: Each undiluted sample count Poisson(sample volume * shared concentration), with noninformative Gamma(.5,0) improper prior for rate. Condition on flanking counts, never central count. Center posterior predictive zero probability under declared middle concentration scale rho.

sensitivities.meaning: exactly unchanged local concentration across neighboring sampling visits
hypothetical 75% lower middle-visit concentration than neighbor-estimated density
hypothetical 90% lower middle-visit concentration than neighbor-estimated density

report: All eligible triple centers and their observed zeros

Observed zeros with a model-assigned Pzero<.01 or <.05
